title: 第15章 今天都得给老子死在这第16章 这天下没人能威胁我没有人
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
这没完了是吧。
姜太初看着这状，大脑炸成了一团浆糊。
至于牧尘等人，早已经瑟瑟发抖起来了。
他们不是傻子。
自然能感受得出，来人绝不比陈霸道弱多少。
而最重要的是，来的人并不是一个，而是整整十六个。
只是不知道的是，这些人到底是冲着谁来的。
而陈红眠和陈无敌，则是下意识将陈稳护在身后。
我……靠！！！
这些人不会是冲着我来的吧。
陈稳脑子里顿时升起一个可怕的念头来。
“不是，芍子姐。”
“你不是说天命大熔炉能屏蔽天机的吗？”
“我这才装了半集的逼，就被发现了？”
“你不觉得你那牛逼吹得有点大吗？”
显然，陈稳以为是因为他的混沌序列体被发现，才引来的敌。
“第一，老娘是芍药的芍，不是勺子的勺。”
“第二，这并不是天命大熔炉的问题，而是你本身就犯天命。”
“第三，再叫老娘芍子姐，头都给你打爆了。”
“不是，什么叫我本身就犯天命？”陈稳人傻了。

“问你爹娘去吧。”仙红芍淡淡道。
我……
不是，你就不能说清楚一点吗。
陈稳人都麻了。
也许是注意到了陈稳脸色的变化。
陈红眠悠悠开口道：“有些事一两句话解释不清楚，但你放心吧，有我们在没人能伤害你。”
“现在是老爹和老娘的战场了，我们看的就行。”陈无敌跟着附和道。
陈稳刚想要细问是什么意思时，天地间那动荡不止的异象，打断了他的思绪。
只见天空开始泛涌着一条条规则法链，不断地交错辉映着。
乍然看起来斑驳不已，但却流转着古老而神秘的天命道韵。
在规则衍至极致，并将整方天地封锁禁锢住时，那十六道裂缝终于往外撑开了。
下一刻，一尊尊高大，气势滔然，浩光缠绕的男女从中跨出。
content_en:
This is not over, right?
Seeing this, Jiang Taichu's brain exploded into a ball of paste.
As for Muchen and others, they were already trembling.
They are not fools.
Naturally, one can feel that the person coming is definitely not much weaker than Chen Badao.
And the most important thing is that there is not one person coming, but a total of sixteen people.
What I don’t know is who these people are coming for.
Chen Hongmian and Chen Wudi subconsciously protected Chen Wen behind them.
I...fuck! ! !
These people are not coming for me.
A terrible thought suddenly came to Chen Wen's mind.
"No, Sister Shaozi."
"Didn't you say that the melting pot of destiny can shield the secrets of heaven?"
"I've only been pretending to be cool for half an episode, and now I'm discovered?"
"Don't you think your bragging is a bit exaggerated?"
Obviously, Chen Wen thought it was because his Chaos Sequence was discovered that he attracted the enemy.
"First, I am a peony for peony, not a spoon for spoons."
"Second, this is not a problem with the melting pot of destiny, but you yourself are violating destiny."
"Third, if you call me Sister Shaozi again, your head will explode."
"No, what do you mean I am violating destiny?" Chen Wenren was dumbfounded.
"Ask your parents." Xian Hongshao said calmly.
I...
No, can't you make it clearer?
Chen Wen was numb.
Maybe he noticed the change in Chen Wen's expression.
Chen Hongmian said leisurely: "Some things cannot be explained in one or two sentences, but don't worry, no one can hurt you with us here."
"Now it's a battlefield between dad and mom, we can just watch." Chen Wudi echoed.
When Chen Wengang wanted to ask what it meant, the turbulent vision between heaven and earth interrupted his thoughts.
I saw that the sky began to be filled with chains of rules and regulations, constantly intertwining and reflecting.
It may look mottled at first glance, but it carries the ancient and mysterious charm of destiny.
When the rules were developed to the extreme and the entire world was sealed and imprisoned, the sixteen cracks finally opened up.
The next moment, a man and a woman who were tall, imposing, and shrouded in light stepped out.
